newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat ends mixed, mostly lower.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat ends mixed, mostly lower.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures ended mixed but mostly lower in what traders said was a consolidation from Thursday's active volume.

"The fundamentals showed up yesterday -- we had some large hedge-selling and so we traded heavy volumes," a MGE source said. "Today was quite a different story... we had a small amount of hedge pressure."
Traders noted that the key December/March spread widened slightly to seven cents bid at the close, versus six cents bid throughout much of the session.

MGE spring wheat closed 2-1/2 cents per bushel lower to 3/4 cent higher, with December down 1/2 cent at $3.85-1/4. All contracts out to September 1997 set new contract lows, with Dec hitting a new low at $3.84.
Traders said Atwood/Peavey bought 1.5 million March bushels and sold one million Dec. Wilson bought 1.5 million Dec and sold one million March. LFG sold 1.3 million March.
MGE barley futures did not trade.
